app.name: DearYou
app.tagline: Wedding and festive looks, decided together

footer.privacy: Photos are deleted automatically. Location is kept to city level.
footer.madeWith: Made for families who decide together.

common.regionsError: We couldn't load the list of countries. Check your connection and try again.

landing.eyebrow: Virtual try-on for weddings and festivals
landing.heroSubtitle: Try on complete outfits, jewellery and makeup on your own photo, then send one link so everyone — from Maa to your cousins abroad — can vote Haan, Hmm or Na.
landing.heroIllustrationAlt: Abstract line illustration of a person in a draped outfit with earrings, glowing in marigold light
landing.stepsIntro: Three simple steps, under five minutes to your first look.

try.title: Try on
try.body: Upload one photo and see three complete looks — outfit, jewellery, makeup and hair — built for your event.

vote.title: Family votes
vote.body: Share one link on WhatsApp. Family vote in their own language — no app, no sign-up.

decide.title: Decide together
decide.body: See where everyone agrees, apply their suggestions, and lock the look you all love.

landing.trustTitle: Your photos, your family, your call

deletion.title: Photos auto-deleted
deletion.body: Your photos and renders are deleted automatically after {{hours}} hours — or instantly, whenever you ask.

noJudgment.title: No skin judgments
noJudgment.body: We match colours to your look. We never score, rank or comment on your skin.

location.title: City level only
location.body: We use your location only to find the nearest city. Exact coordinates are never kept.

brides.label: Every bride, every tradition
brides.alt: {{bride}}: an original line drawing sketched under an arch, with glowing petals falling

location.sheetIntro: We use this to show prices in your currency and events your family celebrates.
location.explainBody: Your browser will ask to share your location once. We only keep the nearest city — never your exact coordinates.
location.unsupported: DearYou isn't available where you are yet. You can still pick a country and city below.
location.denied: Location permission was turned off. No problem — pick your country and city below.
location.unavailable: We couldn't get your location on this device. Please pick your country and city below.
location.error: Something went wrong while finding your city. Please pick it below.

setup.title: Set up your event

location.title: Confirm your location
location.help: We'll show prices in your currency and the events celebrated where you are.

role.title: Who are you dressing as?
role.help: This helps us suggest the right weight of outfit and jewellery.

event.title: Which event?
event.help: Pick one — you can set up more events later.

date.title: When is it?
date.help: We'll plan your prep timeline backwards from this date.

budget.title: What's your budget?
budget.help: For the complete look: outfit, jewellery and makeup.

style.title: What's your style?
style.help: Pick as many as you like.

summary.title: Here's your event
summary.help: Check everything looks right. You can change any answer.

setup.dateInvalid: Please choose a date from today onwards.
setup.budgetInvalid: Please enter an amount greater than zero.
setup.eventsEmpty: No events listed for this country yet.
setup.submitNote: Next: take a photo or upload one from your gallery.
setup.draftSaved: Your answers are saved on this device.
setup.submitError: We couldn't save your event. Check your connection and try again.
setup.consent: I agree that my photos are used only to create my looks, are never used to judge my skin, and are deleted automatically after {{hours}} hours.

room.title: Family Room
room.body: Your family will open this link to vote Haan, Hmm or Na on each look — in Bengali, Hindi or English.

studio.title: Look Studio
studio.body: Three complete looks, layer by layer — outfit, jewellery, makeup and hair — each checked for accuracy.

pack.title: Decision Pack
pack.body: Your final look with a shopping list, a brief for your makeup artist and a prep countdown.

store.title: Store Insights
store.body: What families agree on, by event and region — for the stores that dress them.

demo.title: Demo family
demo.body: A ready-made family with looks and votes, so you can try every feature without uploading a photo.

notFound.title: This page wandered off
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

auth.title: Welcome to DearYou
auth.subtitle: Sign in to build your looks and share them with your family.
auth.errorInvalid: That username and password don't match. Please try again.
auth.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.errorGeneric: We couldn't sign you in right now. Check your connection and try again.
auth.demoBody: Judges can use this account. Tap “Fill in”, then “Sign in”.
auth.demoFilled: Filled in — now tap Sign in
auth.familyNote: Family members never need an account — they vote straight from the shared link.

intro.full: Your looks are built on this photo — outfit, jewellery, makeup and hair.
intro.face: Optional. A clear close-up helps match makeup shades and colours to you.

full.1: Stand about 2 metres away, facing the camera
full.2: Whole body in the frame, head to feet

face.1: Face fills most of the frame

light.warn: Light could be better — try facing a window
light.fail: Too dark — move to brighter light

sharp.warn: A little blurry — hold steady or use the timer

face.warn: More than one person found — the photo should show only you
face.fail: We couldn't find a face — face the camera in good light

face_size_full.warn: You're quite far away — step a little closer

face_size_face.warn: Move closer so your face fills more of the frame

framing.warn: Step back so your whole body fits in the frame

errors.too_large: That file is larger than 12 MB. Please choose a smaller photo.
errors.not_image: That file isn't a photo we can read. Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.unsupported_format: Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.too_small: That photo is too small. Please use one at least 320 pixels wide.
errors.generic: We couldn't upload your photo. Check your connection and try again.

photo.privacy: Your photos are private and deleted automatically after {{hours}} hours.

hint.face: Fit your face inside the oval.

errors.unsupported: This browser can't open the live camera here.

studio.intro: Your photos are saved. Three complete looks for your {{event}} will appear here.

card.planning: Picking pieces from the catalogue for this look…

lightbox.aiNote: Product pictures are AI-generated illustrations. The try-on itself is rendered on your own photo by YouCam.

wear.title: Which looks should we build?
wear.body: Pick the styling for your three looks. Each one is rendered on your own photo.
wear.womenLayers: Outfit, necklace, earrings, makeup and hair

live.note: Your looks are rendered live by YouCam on your own photo, one layer at a time. It takes a few minutes — you can leave this page and come back.
live.doneNote: Tap a look to see how it came together, layer by layer.

rebuild.confirm: This replaces your three current looks with new ones. Build new looks?
rebuild.waitFinish: You can rebuild once these looks finish.
rebuild.none: No rebuilds left for this session.

errors.photo_required: Add a full-length photo first, so the looks can be rendered on you.
errors.round_limit: You've used every rebuild for this session.
errors.catalogue_empty: Our catalogue is still being prepared. Please try again in a minute.
